parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The cluster or region ID. This parameter is required. For example, `cn-hangzhou`.

parameters.name: ConfigKey
parameters.description: The dynamic parameter name. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description: The configuration type. This parameter is required. Currently, only `service` is supported.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The service name. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The request body. This parameter is required.
